data.text:
Mansoor Alam vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Food ... on 
9 July, 2024 
Author: Sangeeta Chandra
Bench: Sangeeta Chandra
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:46472-Db
Court No. - 3
Case :- Writ - C No. - 5916 of 2024
Petitioner :- Mansoor Alam 
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Food Safety And Drug Administration Lk Counsel for Petitioner :- Shikhar Chaube,Akshya Tiwari,Saurabh Singh Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Anil Kumar Tripathi Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Standing Counsel for State-respondents and Shri Ajitanshu Tripathi, Advocate holding brief of Shri Anil Kumar Tripathi, learned counsel for respondent no.3.
2. This petition has been filed with the following main prayers:-
"I. Issue a writ, order or direction in nature of mandamus commanding & directing the opposite party no. 4 to consider and decide the representation dated 11.03.2024,
as contained in Annexure No. 1 to this writ petition, within a short and reasonable Mansoor Alam vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Food ... on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70900953/
1 time as prescribed by this Hon'ble Court, in the interest of justice. 
II. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding &
directing the opposite parties/ authorities concerned to grant, the petitioner, a license as a Food business Operator as provided under Regulation 2.1 (Chapter II) of the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses)
Regulations, 2011 and allow the petitioner to operate his meat shop further commanding the opposite parties not to interfere/disturb in peaceful operation of the meat shop of the petitioner without following due procedure of law."
3. It is the case of the petitioner that the petitioner has already given an application to the Station House Officer, police station Nagar Kotwali, District Gonda, a copy of which has been annexed to the petition. The Station House Officer has yet not taken an appropriate decision, hence, this writ petition. 
4. The learned Standing Counsel has informed this Court that appropriate order directing NOC is to be passed by Superintendent of Police of the District concerned. 
5. This writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the petitioner to make fresh application to the Superintendent of Police, Gonda, within a week from today. If such an application is made, the Superintendent of Police, Gonda shall call for a report from the Station House Officer of the police station concerned and also from Nagar Palika Parishad, Gonda and then pass appropriate order, in accordance with law, within a period of three weeks thereafter. 
(Shree Prakash Singh, J.) (Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra, J.) Order Date :- 9.7.2024 Arnima  Mansoor Alam vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Food ... on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70900953/
